name: SAR9 SOCOM Black
lead: Sarsılmaz's new model SAR9 SOCOM, which is preferred by law enforcement agencies in the United States, offers a professional user experience with its full-size carry features and design suitable for competition use.
description: Sarsılmaz's new model SAR9 SOCOM, which is preferred by law enforcement agencies in the United States, offers a professional user experience with its full-size carry features and design suitable for competition use.

The innovative magwell design, which facilitates magazine changes during firing, increases the comfort of the SAR9 SOCOM's grip and maximizes pistol control. Thanks to its slide design with co-witness feature, SAR9 SOCOM offers the opportunity to use with red-dot as well as optic-ready mechanical sights. The picatinny rail system suitable for accessory integration (flashlight, laser pointer, etc.) in international standards and the flat trigger design with a single-action feature that improves shooting performance maximizes the target success of the SAR9 SOCOM. The slide design of the SAR9 SOCOM provides a high level of user comfort thanks to the increased cooling channels to prevent overheating during continuous firing, and the disassembly catch that facilitates slide tool removal.
